case.request:
덕테이프 포스터로 야외 영화 행사 안내를 만들어줘. 동네 주민에게 친근하면서 성인 문화 행사에 어울리는 느낌이면 좋겠어. 지하철역과 커뮤니티의 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로, 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 상영과 대화라는 행사가 알아보이고 일정·장소·입장·준비 안내가 읽혀야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

conditions: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Outdoor short-film screening and conversation must be recognizable, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

direction.concept: The poster itself acts like the span of a bridge: a broad title pier and long schedule lintel shelter an active screening-and-conversation space.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: A frontal graphic bridge section frames an actual scene: screen on one side, adults on mats across the open floor, and a microphone-bearing adult speaking to seated listeners. The bridge structure is a large nonglyph framing construction; the scene occupies a substantial open arch.
direction.expression_system: Bold architectural graphic construction combines block-like type territories with a frontal, carefully drawn human scene. The large title remains conventional printed lettering on a flat pier; screen, bodies, mats and microphone supply the nonletter event content.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: First gaze: the Korean title stepping down the left pier together with the open cinema arch. Next useful information: date/time across the upper lintel. The event descriptor sits directly above the scene, while the right pier holds practical information in a single usable column.
direction.whole_visual_layout: Left pier x4–35% carries the three title word groups through y12–77%, with English beneath. A long upper-right lintel x42–96%, y8–25% carries date/time. The open arch x38–74%, y42–95% contains the frontal audience/screen scene. Descriptor spans x40–96%, y30–39%; right pier x78–97%, y45–96% holds place and attendance guidance.
direction.typography_plan: Korean title 60–66 px at width720, breaking only as 다리 / 아래 / 영화관; English 17–19 px. Date/time 25–30 px. Descriptor and every right-column entry at least 17 px; use17px practical text with21px leading, preserving full entries at word boundaries. Choose a square, strong Korean sans with controlled counters and normal readable punctuation.
direction.color_material_emotion: A clear mineral blue structural field, warm white text territories and restrained coral accents in the human scene give civic strength with welcoming activity. Clean drawn edges and flat contrast make the architecture and information act as one system.
direction.distinction: Removing color and material still leaves M5's large left title pier, upper schedule lintel, central frontal arch and right practical column. M2 instead surrounds a central date with an overhead horseshoe and distributes information in its open corners. M5 is title-led and vertically anchored; M2 is date-led and inward-gathering.

reference_observations.observed_principle: The second viewed cache has very large green type around the perimeter and a central dark irregular opening with curled, torn-looking edges; small information follows narrow side territories. Occlusion and scale make the outside and inside of the sheet interact.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Make a bridge-shaped perimeter organize the large title and schedule while an intentionally open center carries the screening scene. Replace obscuration with a complete readable title, and replace the empty torn hole with meaningful human activity.

reference_observations.observed_principle: The first viewed cache integrates letters, gestures, segmented forms and overlapping colored planes, with local small information pockets. The large forms and typography share directional and physical boundaries.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Fit title, lintel, scene and practical pier as one interlocking structure. Keep the current scene and Korean lettering intact, rather than importing its characters, comic hand shapes or decorative lettering.

direction.positive_construction: Build the two piers and upper span as the landscape's major shapes, fit the actual title word groups and schedule to those territories, then make the central arch visibly host screening and conversation. Keep the narrow practical pier wide enough for 17 px text and intentional wraps. The practical pier must fit its eight planned lines and four group gaps; reserve its full width for type without hidden extra inset.

copy_groups.role: Title as the strong left support
copy_groups.position_relationship: Left pier x4–35%, y12–86%; title uses its three original word groups on three lines, English on a separate readable baseline below.
Upper-right lintel x42–96%, y8–25%; date and time align across or stack within one broad territory.
Horizontal opening immediately above the scene, x40–96%, y30–39%; full descriptor with a clear flat baseline.

Right pier x78-97%, y45-96%, with the full137px width available: venue wraps as 홍제천 연가교 / 아래; access as 무료 관람 · / 선착순 80명; weather as 우천 시 실내로 / 변경. Slash here marks a soft line break and is NOT printed. Arrival and mat entries stay on one line. Use17px text,21px leading and about7px between original entry groups. If more leading is needed, move the top to y42% rather than shrinking type.
